name: linkedin-agent
description: Twelve Claude skills that run a LinkedIn account: posts off 21 hook formulas, comments, replies, profile score, weekly plan, DMs, inbox triage, carousels, repurposing, audits, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint and scores the draft before it goes out. Fork adds li-safe (public sector content check), career mode for profiles, and a technical keep list for the humanizer.

author.name: Raul Mendez Patarroyo (fork of Jake Schincariol)
